### 2026-09-27 update — AADP -04 (CANDIDATE / NOT EXECUTION-AUTHORIZED)
Primary source: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-saha-aadp-04

Revision -04 was published today. Decision-relevant delta: budget evidence now optionally exposes `consumed` and `window_resets_at`, budget `name` is unique within the PDP and tied to the failing evaluation-trace rule, and the reference implementation has closed several -03 gaps (HTTP `approval_ref`, exact decimal-string bounds, evaluation trace, mandate-layer deferral, action-bound permits). Two reservation-resolution divergences remain explicitly open.

Most useful invariant for our receipts: **budget state is part of evidence, not merely policy**; a denial can identify which budget failed, how much was consumed/remaining, and when the window resets. This makes `BLOCK:budget_exhausted` mechanically explainable rather than opaque.

Smallest falsification: construct two same-action denials under distinct daily/monthly budgets and verify the evidence uniquely identifies the failing budget/rule and reconstructs remaining/consumed/reset state. Fail if two materially different budget states serialize to indistinguishable audit evidence.

No execution, mailbox dispatch, CLAIM, Work/Codex/NICLI/local runner, payment, deployment, or downstream action is authorized by this comment.
